visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens outdoors in natural daylight. A man with dark, slightly messy hair is dressed in a dark blue and black wetsuit, meticulously preparing a black surfboard near a vehicle. (2) The scene cuts to a long shot of the ocean where the same man is surfing on a white-capped wave under an overcast sky. (3) Transitioning back to the shore, the man walks across a grey, pebbled beach toward the camera, carrying his surfboard and smiling brightly. (4) A young woman with long dark hair is then shown in a black wetsuit on a beach, adjusting a vibrant pink surfboard. (5) A series of rapid close-up shots follow, focusing on the eyes of various men (including the main character and a Caucasian man) to highlight facial wrinkles and crow's feet, framed in a bright, outdoor beach setting. (6) The setting shifts to a warm, indoor domestic environment with soft lighting. The man is sitting at a table when a hand enters the frame to present a gold-foiled product packet. (7) In a close-up, the man opens the packet, removes white crescent-shaped eye patches, and carefully applies them under his eyes while looking into a handheld mirror. (8) The woman is then seen in a bright indoor setting, demonstrating the product's packaging, showing the moisture-rich patches, and applying them to her own face to show the fit. (9) The video concludes in a retail store setting with shelves stocked with 'Quality 1st' products, followed by a final shot of the man gesturing with the eye patches on.
